text: feature, fix, refactor: Update packages: pak::pak() Run tests — confirm passing changes: devtools::test(reporter = "check"). fail, stop ask. Plan — identify affected R files; check new exports needed. Test first — write failing test, implement: devtools::test(filter = "name", reporter = "check"). Implement — minimal code pass tests. Refactor — clean , keep tests green. Document — document new changed exports. Verify: Run devtools::test(reporter = "check"), devtools::check(error_on = "warning"). Resolve warnings, errors, NOTEs. User-facing changes . 1 line, end . Present tense, positive framing, function names (backticks + ()) near start: * `fn()` now accepts ... * Fixed ... Issue/contributor final period: * `fn()` now accepts ... (@user, #N). #N GitHub issue number implemented (e.g. #42). Get username: gh api user --jq .login; get issue number user’s prompt, branch name (git branch --show-current), gh issue list. Never guess invent issue number. writing , verify: (1) received user branch name, (2) looked gh. trace number concrete source, use #noissue.

Visit Zoom Created Apps — zoom_browse_app_management
text: Launch Zoom "Created Apps" page (can configure OAuth 2.0 Clients). Navigate "Develop > Build App" app, choose "OAuth".

title: Visit Zoom Created Apps — zoom_browse_app_management
text: One-time relay setup (Zoom longer accepts localhost redirect URIs): Create Cloudflare Worker using script system.file("cloudflare/oauth-relay.js", package = "zoomer"). Worker reads local port OAuth state parameter issues 302 redirect http://localhost:{port}/callback. Set Zoom app's OAuth Redirect URL Worker's URL (e.g. https://zoomer-oauth.-handle.workers.dev/callback). Add options(zoom.redirect_url = "https://...") .Rprofile. Optionally set options(zoom.redirect_port = 1410L) need non-default local port. configuring app, copy/paste Client ID Client Secret ZOOM_CLIENT_ID ZOOM_CLIENT_SECRET environment variables. recommend placing .Renviron file.
